title: DemoBias: An Empirical Study to Trace Demographic Biases in Vision Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic similarity of generated text descriptions for face images using group-specific BERTScores and calculating the Fairness Discrepancy Rate (FDR) across eight distinct ethnic/racial groups (e.g., African, Caucasian, Hispanic/Latino, East Asian).

Comparing text generation performance for biometric face recognition by calculating group-specific BERTScores and Fairness Discrepancy Rate (FDR) between male and female subjects within and across racial groups.

Measuring performance variability and semantic consistency in model-generated facial descriptions using BERTScores and Fairness Discrepancy Rate (FDR) across three age categories: Young, Middle Age, and Senior.
